title: Before it arrives
text: What do you do with your first touch?
tip: Look before the ball arrives, then decide.

options.why: You looked first, so you already knew the forward pass was on.

options.text: Take a touch and look up
options.why: It keeps the ball, but the chance to go forward may have gone.
Safe, but you missed the better pass you could have seen.

scan.prompt: Ball's coming to you from the left. Look first.
